cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.

mechanism: A corrects the technique of comforting B while A's own distress increasingly defeats the performance of competence.
confusable: Ordinary caregiving differs from visibly worsening personal distress while intensifying care for the other person.
comparison: Shared layoffs expose shaking hands; a choir rejection exposes inability to swallow while serving supper.
seedUse: Keep B's concern as a real contribution and show A redirecting it into more expertly managed care.
